albums.description: We hope you enjoy these photo's taken at Fronteers: Dark Mode 2026! Some of these photo's show the boat trip we organised for our speakers and guests through the canals of Dordrecht. Others show our volunteers preparing the venue and then of course the event itself. We loved seeing so many of you in person again, and we hope you enjoyed the conference as much as we did!
albums.objections: If you object to any of the photos shared here (because you're in them), please contact conference@fronteers.nl. Be sure to mention the album name and the photo number when contacting us. We'll remove the photo from the album as soon as possible.
